hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: A number of ancient European and Ancient Near Eastern languages are not listed in E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29. One of them is Bolgarian, a Turkic language ancestral to or subgrouping with Chuvash [chv] (**hh:ld:Benzing:Hunnische**, **hh:lde:Zimonyi:Volga-Bulghars**, **hh:ld:Pritsak:Bulgarischen**, **hh:ld:Erdal:Wolgabolgarischen**). See also: Chuvash [chv].
